name: subtrack
description: SubTrack - Subscription Management System with integrated frontend and backend

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd subtrack-frontend && npm install && cd ../subtrack-backend && npm install
scripts.build: cd subtrack-frontend && npm run build && cd ../subtrack-backend && npm run build
scripts.lint: cd subtrack-frontend && npm run lint && cd ../subtrack-backend && npm run lint
scripts.typecheck: cd subtrack-frontend && npm run typecheck && cd ../subtrack-backend && npm run typecheck

author: SubTrack Team
